name: gmail
description: Highly popular email service by Google. Gmail tracks all of your email conversations.

setup.title: Create a Google Cloud OAuth app

steps.text: Enable the Gmail API for your Google Cloud project.
On the OAuth consent screen, set User type to Internal.
steps.why: Internal avoids the Google app verification and annual CASA security assessment that Gmail's restricted scopes otherwise require, and stops refresh tokens expiring every 7 days.

steps.text: In Credentials, create an OAuth client ID of type Web application, then add this redirect URI to its Authorised redirect URIs:
steps.why: Google rejects the authorization if the redirect URI does not match character for character, including the scheme and any trailing slash.

notes.authorize: Sign in as the SHARED MAILBOX ACCOUNT, not as yourself. Whichever account approves this is the mailbox everyone will read — read-only, so nothing can be sent, labelled or deleted.
notes.verify: This reports which mailbox you are actually connected to — worth reading before you rely on it.

scopes.description: Manage drafts and send emails when you interact with the add-on.
View your email messages when you interact with the add-on.
See and edit your email labels.
View your email message metadata when the add-on is running.
View your email messages when the add-on is running.

Read, compose, send, and permanently delete all your email from Gmail. Note: Request this scope only if your application needs to immediately and permanently delete threads and messages, bypassing the trash. You can perform all other actions using less permissive scopes.
View your email messages and settings.
Add emails into your Gmail mailbox.
Read, compose, and send emails from your Gmail account. This scope does not allow immediate, permanent deletion of threads and messages, bypassing the trash.
View your email message metadata such as labels and headers, but not the email body.
See, edit, create, or change your email settings and filters in Gmail.

Manage your sensitive mail settings, including who can manage your mail. Note: Operations guarded by this scope are restricted to administrative use only. They are only available to Google Workspace customers using a service account with domain-wide delegation.

telemetry.description: Searched messages and read their contents
